impact:
ManifestDoc gets two layers of validation: decodeEnvelope (wrapper: kind/schemaVersion/checksum) AND assertManifestInvariants (store.ts:353) for its body shape, called at store.ts:251, 657 and 840. GenerationDoc gets only the first. store.ts:841 does `const doc = decodeEnvelope("generation", path, raw) as GenerationDoc` and assigns it straight to `active` — a type assertion, not a check. classifyStore does the same ungated decode at store.ts:267.

Consequence: a generation whose envelope is well-formed and whose checksum matches, but whose BODY is structurally malformed (missing provenance, missing coverage, non-object sourceVersion) is classified "usable" and served as the active snapshot rather than quarantined. The reader's quarantine path exists and works; this class of damage simply never reaches it. deriveFreshness (store.ts:883) spreads provenance.coverage and would throw on it.

Caveat on urgency, verified: deriveFreshness currently has zero callers and readSnapshot is not yet wired into the CLI, so the concrete throw is not reachable today. This is a gap to close before the module is consumed (T-012/T-013), not a live defect.

Fix shape: an assertGenerationInvariants mirroring the manifest one, called wherever a generation is decoded — and per this repo's mutation discipline, a test that observes it refusing.
title: [T-010] Generation bodies are decoded but never invariant-checked before being served
